policies.external: not yet: LASER currently wires ego via LASER_EGO / TRANSFUSER_CKPT inside its own runner; a policy bridge like OSC2's osc2carla_policy_bridge.py is future work

notes.identity: LASER (LLM-assisted scenario execution) running closed-loop CARLA episodes with scripted/LLM NPCs and a sensorimotor ego (TransFuser / InterFuser).
notes.closed_loop: Ego is controlled by the selected AD stack each tick. NPC agents follow LASER scripts (1-step scripts use hold-speed fallback without calling the LLM).
notes.observation_spaces: sensor only for native policies. Analytic state policies (idm, constant) are not supported yet; run.py reports failure with a reason rather than inventing a bridge.
notes.overtake: Maps to SafeBench Vehicle Passing / ManeuverOppositeDirection (blocking vehicle + oncoming traffic on a two-way road).
notes.red_light: Town10HD_Opt junction 189; ego green / cross red; runner waits then goes when ego is near the conflict.
notes.seed: Recorded and exported as SCENARIO_ORCHESTRATION_SEED / PYTHONHASHSEED. CARLA physics still contributes residual nondeterminism.
notes.carla: Assumes a CARLA server is already listening (CARLA_HOST / CARLA_PORT, default 127.0.0.1:2000). run.py does not start the UE4 process.
notes.trace: No dense per-step trace yet. method_metrics references se_records artifacts (time.txt, collisions.txt, video when present).
